basis: Inherited ornithine metabolism disorder; ocular and neurologic manifestations vary across subtypes and are not established across the umbrella.
Neurometabolic disorders of dopamine synthesis defined by dystonia; no additional organ damage common across the group.
Skeletal hyperostosis; facial palsy 2/2, hearing impairment 1/2 and nail dysplasia 1/2 support additional axes, although the cohort is tiny.
Peripheral nerve sheath tumour arising in the posterior mediastinum; mediastinal location alone does not establish pulmonary damage.
Carcinoma originating in the pituitary endocrine gland; Cushing disease and metastatic organ damage are not assumed.
Primary laryngeal carcinoma; the larynx belongs to the pulmonary axis. Distant metastatic involvement is not established as common.
ACAN-related skeletal growth and cartilage disorder; short stature, accelerated skeletal maturation and joint abnormalities remain within one axis.
Defined by sensorineural hearing loss and skin/hair pigmentation abnormalities; iris colour differences do not establish ocular dysfunction.
Hepatopathy ~100%, muscle injury with elevated CK 59%, cardiomyopathy 38%; cap omits cleft palate 78% and coagulation abnormalities 40-50%.
Retinitis pigmentosa, hair/nail dysplasia and dental anomalies define the syndrome; teeth belong to gastrointestinal.
Intellectual disability and micrognathia define the syndrome; dental anomalies occur in 30-79%, crowding in 3/4. Recurrent infections alone do not establish immunodeficiency.
Chromosome 16q deletion umbrella commonly causes developmental delay or intellectual disability; other organ malformations depend on the deleted region.
GM2 storage causes progressive infantile neurodegeneration; progressive visual loss from retinal neuronal degeneration occurs in most, beyond a non-damaging cherry-red spot.
Calcium-sensing disorder causing usually benign hypercalcemia; hypocalciuria is altered handling, not renal damage. Stones and pancreatitis are uncommon separate complications.
Glycine metabolism defect; persistent CK elevation with muscle fatigability supports muscle injury in the single reported case. Odour does not imply skin damage.
Inherited non-syndromic lens cataract; no extraocular disease is established.
Hearing loss is characteristic; dental abnormalities 80-99% and optic atrophy 30-79%. Cap omits hypertension reported at 30-79%.
Neurodegeneration and photosensitivity define disease; retinopathy and hearing loss 80-99%. Cap omits contractures, hepatic abnormalities, dental defects and renal involvement.
Transient neonatal hyperammonemia; direct hyperammonemic encephalopathy with seizures or coma occurs in most symptomatic cases. Respiratory distress alone does not prove lung damage.
Severe inherited skin blistering; oral mucosal blistering is characteristic and reported in 1/1 annotated patient. Airway damage is not established as common.
Inherited susceptibility specifically targets colorectal neoplasia; this label identifies the target organ and does not imply existing cancer or extraintestinal damage.
Benign keratotic tumour arising from follicular structures in the skin.
Disease of coronary arteries with stenosis and myocardial ischemic consequences, all within the cardiovascular axis.
Skin/hair/nail dysplasia and oral clefts/dental defects define disease; intellectual disability and hypogonadism each 30-79%. Cap omits skeletal anomalies.
Sarcoma originates in the gallbladder, which belongs to the hepatic axis; mesenchymal histology alone does not establish locomotor involvement.
